fixes.explanation: Taunt is the word, friend. “How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You?” (Psalm 74:10) A taunt is an insult aimed at someone, and here Asaph says it's aimed at God. He brings that question straight to Him.

True, friend. Asaph says to God, “You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.” (Psalm 74:15) These are rivers that were ever-flowing, and the verse says He dried them up. That's a lot of water to deal with.
